customManagers.description: Bundled GLPI release, pin 1 of 3: .glpi-version (a bare version on the first line). One manager per file so a pattern can only ever run against the file it was written for.
Bundled GLPI release, pin 2 of 3: ARG GLPI_VERSION in both Dockerfile stages. Renovate's built-in managers only see FROM lines; the tarball is fetched by version.
Bundled GLPI release, pin 3 of 3: the docker-bake.hcl default.

packageRules.description: GLPI major and minor bumps are a compatibility decision (schema, PHP requirements); the bot proposes patch releases only.
The version is also named in prose (README, issue template, runbooks, a config comment); those lines are not managed here and go stale silently.
prBodyNotes: :pencil: Before merging, grep the repository for the previous version string (`git grep -n '{{{currentValue}}}'`) and bump every prose mention on this branch: README, issue template, runbooks, CONTRIBUTING, the nginx config comment. Those lines are not managed by Renovate.
